systems.system: Hubiye, e-Aqoonsi and Certificate Delivery System (CDS)

SOM.note: Platforms are said to enhance issuance and verification, but no online ID check or authentication service is stated.
Gives only a target of 15 million registered by 2029, no enrolled count.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Says in-house expertise covers software development, policy and coordination with partners; does not say who operates or owns the platform.
No register keyed on the ID stated.

facts.fact: NIRA's Director General told ID4Africa 2025 that Somalia has built a unified foundational digital ID system with registration centres expanded across the country and platforms for identity issuance.

SOM.note: Iris capture is only on the roadmap.

facts.fact: NIRA's Director General said the authority focused its in-house expertise on software development, policy oversight and coordination, and rolled out homegrown platforms Hubiye, e-Aqoonsi and the Certificate Delivery System.
